methodology.landmarks: Apple Vision CPU, every native frame; one face and confidence >=0.8 required. Vision yaw/roll are coarse quantized estimates, not continuous pose truth. Eye-line angle is continuous detector geometry.
methodology.eyes: Pupil changes only between adjacent eligible open-eye/confident frames, normalized by eye width/height; not iris segmentation. Roll-corrected aperture. Low-aperture candidates retain the existing 45%-of-segment-p90 heuristic, not a medical/identity verdict.
methodology.color: Median approximate forehead/cheek face patches intersected with contour, uncalibrated sRGB -> Lab D65, adjacent Delta E76. Not validated skin segmentation.
methodology.motion: Face box center step/acceleration; 128x128 normalized luma translation phase correlation within 8 pixels, not optical flow or an identity metric.
methodology.limits: Expression, pose, lighting and detector jitter confound all perceptual proxies. No automatic acceptance. A/V offsets are stream timing, not lip sync.
